description: MEDIEVALKIT demo built only from the village, castle, props, nature and terrain kits: a market square, its tavern, a castle gate over a moat and the torchlit throne room beyond. Original names and designs.

endings.text: Ysolde sets your petition beside the throne. "The hall has heard you, wayfarer."

flags.description: Mirela told you how the warden opens the gate
The steward has heard your petition

interactions.label: Read the notice board
interactions.text: Pinned notes, all blank but one: the steward of Greywatch hears petitions at the turning of the bell.

interactions.label: Talk to Mirela
interactions.text: Mirela slides a cup across. "The castle? Tobin keeps the gate. Tell him the Lantern sent you, he owes me for a winter's ale. Take a lantern, the road is dark under the gate."

interactions.label: Look at the keg
interactions.text: Brown ale, still cold from the cellar. The tap is worn bright.

interactions.label: Talk to Tobin
interactions.text: Tobin grunts at the name of the Lantern, then hauls on the winch. The portcullis grinds up.

interactions.label: Present your petition
interactions.text: Ysolde reads your letter twice, then nods. "Greywatch will send grain to your valley before the frost."

metadata.medievalkit_note: Built only from MEDIEVALKIT kits (kits/core/gen_medievalkit_*.py) by data: tools/medievalkit_rooms.py snaps every piece to the MEDIEVAL GRID and checks the socket manifest kits/library/medievalkit-sockets.json. Generated by tools/medievalkit_demo.py.

rooms.description: Hollowmere's market square. Cobbles ring an old well, the Crooked Lantern leans over the north side, and a postern in the town wall opens on the castle road.
rooms.name: Hollowmere Square

rooms.description: The Crooked Lantern's tap-room. A fire crackles in the inglenook, lanterns burn on the beams and Mirela polishes tankards behind the barrels.
rooms.name: The Crooked Lantern

rooms.description: Greywatch's gate. A drawbridge spans the moat to a twin-towered gatehouse; the portcullis is down and the warden Tobin keeps the bridge.

doors.label: Back down the road to the square

rooms.name: The Greywatch Gate

rooms.description: The great hall of Greywatch. Torches line the walls, a red runner leads to the dais, and the steward Ysolde waits beside the empty throne.
rooms.name: The Hall of Greywatch

tide.wait_text: A cart rattles by; somewhere a bell counts the hour.

title: The Wayfarer's Audience
